environment: Unity 6000.3.24f1, Windows Editor, Meta XR Simulator and official Meta XR Operator 205; no Quest hardware
testMethod: One Play session with OpenXR Operator right-controller Grip input and simulated physical headset movement; Unity scene pose readback and Editor audio-call logs

steps.action: Move simulated headset near the repair bench; position right controller at the core and press Grip
Move the held right controller to the socket
Release right-controller Grip at the socket
Move the simulated headset through the open hatch to the exit

limitations: Headset displacement represented physical movement; this session did not recheck controller teleport.
Editor logs prove calls to Unity AudioSource.PlayOneShot, not audible output level or left-right localization.
This is Meta XR Simulator evidence, not a Quest headset recording or student-operated demonstration.
